translations.khattab: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers
translations.arberry: And remind; the Reminder profits the believers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
translations.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
translations.khattab: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers
translations.arberry: And remind; the Reminder profits the believers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ

translations.saheeh: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
translations.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
translations.khattab: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman
translations.arberry: Therefore remind! by thy Lord's blessing thou art not a soothsayer neither possessed.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
translations.pickthall: Are yours the males and His the females?
translations.khattab: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters
translations.arberry: What, have you males, and He females?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا

translations.saheeh: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
translations.pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
translations.khattab: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
translations.arberry: So turn thou from him who turns away from Our Remembrance, and desires only the present life.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
translations.pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
translations.khattab: And He created the pairs—males and females—
translations.arberry: and that He Himself created the two kinds, male and female,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: And We left it for a sign. Is there any that will remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
translations.pickthall: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
translations.khattab: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
translations.arberry: Has the Reminder been cast upon him alone among us? Nay, rather he is an impudent liar.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
translations.arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
translations.pickthall: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.khattab: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful
translations.arberry: We have destroyed the likes of you; is there any that will remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
translations.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
translations.khattab: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful
translations.arberry: You have known the first growth; so why will you not remember?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَمَتَٰعࣰ ا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ

translations.saheeh: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
translations.pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
translations.khattab: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers
translations.arberry: We Ourselves made it for a reminder, and a boon to the desert-dwellers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞أَلَمۡ يَأۡنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن تَخۡشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمۡ لِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَدُ فَقَسَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
translations.pickthall: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.
translations.khattab: Has the time not yet come for believers’ hearts to be humbled at the remembrance of Allah and what has been revealed of the truth, and not be like those given the Scripture before—˹those˺ who were spoiled for so long that their hearts became hardened. And many of them are ˹still˺ rebellious
translations.arberry: Is it not time that the hearts of those who believe should be humbled to the Remembrance of God and the Truth which He has sent down, and that they should not be as those to whom the Book was given aforetime, and the term seemed over long to them, so that their hearts have become hard, and many of them are ungodly?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱسۡتَحۡوَذَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمۡ ذِكۡرَ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

translations.saheeh: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.
translations.pickthall: The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers?
translations.khattab: Satan has taken hold of them, causing them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are the party of Satan. Surely Satan’s party is bound to lose
translations.arberry: Satan has gained the mastery over them, and caused them to forget God's Remembrance. Those are Satan's party; why, Satan's party, surely, they are the losers!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.
translations.khattab: O believers! When the call to prayer is made on Friday, then proceed ˹diligently˺ to the remembrance of Allah and leave off ˹your˺ business. That is best for you, if only you knew
translations.arberry: O believers, when proclamation is made for prayer on the Day of Congregation, hasten to God's remembrance and leave trafficking aside; that is better for you, did you but know.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ

translations.saheeh: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed.
translations.pickthall: And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful.
translations.khattab: Once the prayer is over, disperse throughout the land and seek the bounty of Allah. And remember Allah often so you may be successful
translations.arberry: Then, when the prayer is finished, scatter in the land and seek God's bounty, and remember God frequently; haply you will prosper.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلۡهِكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers.
translations.khattab: O believers! Do not let your wealth or your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. For whoever does so, it is they who are the ˹true˺ losers
translations.arberry: O believers, let not your possessions neither your children divert you from God's remembrance; whoso does that, they are the losers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ اۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ قَدۡ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an.
translations.pickthall: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder,
translations.khattab: Allah has ˹also˺ prepared for them a severe punishment. So fear Allah, O people of reason and faith. Allah has indeed revealed to you a Reminder
translations.arberry: God prepared for them a terrible chastisement. So fear God, O men possessed of minds! Believers, God has sent down to you, for a remembrance,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
translations.pickthall: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
translations.khattab: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”
translations.arberry: The unbelievers wellnigh strike thee down with their glances, when they hear the Reminder, and they say, 'Surely he is a man possessed!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
translations.pickthall: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
translations.khattab: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world
translations.arberry: And it is nothing but a Reminder unto all beings.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
translations.pickthall: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
translations.khattab: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it
translations.arberry: that We might make it a reminder for you and for heeding ears to hold.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.saheeh: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
translations.pickthall: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
translations.khattab: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful
translations.arberry: nor the speech of a soothsayer (little do you remember).

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةࣱ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

translations.saheeh: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
translations.pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
translations.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺
translations.arberry: Surely it is a Reminder to the godfearing;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
translations.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
translations.khattab: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
translations.arberry: that We might try them therein. And whosoever turns away from the Remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into chastisement rigorous.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
translations.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
translations.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly
translations.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
translations.pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
translations.khattab: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
translations.arberry: Surely this is a Reminder; so let him who will take unto his Lord a way.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ

translations.saheeh: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
translations.pickthall: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
translations.khattab: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity
translations.arberry: We have appointed only angels to be masters of the Fire, and their number We have appointed only as a trial for the unbelievers, that those who were given the Book may have certainty, and that those who believe may increase in belief, and that those who were given the Book and those who believe may not be in-doubt, and that those in whose hearts there is sickness, and the unbelievers, may say, 'What did God intend by this as a similitude?' So God leads astray whomsoever He will, and He guides whomsoever He will; and none knows the hosts of thy Lord but He. And it is naught but a Reminder to mortals.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
translations.pickthall: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
translations.khattab: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder
translations.arberry: What ails them, that they turn away from the Reminder,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذۡكِرَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
translations.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
translations.khattab: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder
translations.arberry: No indeed; surely it is a Reminder;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

translations.saheeh: Then whoever wills will remember it.
translations.pickthall: So whosoever will may heed.
translations.khattab: So let whoever wills be mindful of it
translations.arberry: so whoever wills shall remember it.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ

translations.saheeh: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
translations.pickthall: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
translations.khattab: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive
translations.arberry: And they will not remember, except that God wills; He is worthy to be feared, -- worthy to forgive.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
translations.pickthall: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
translations.khattab: producing from it both sexes, male and female
translations.arberry: and He made of him two kinds, male and female.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينࣱ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـࣰٔ ا مَّذۡكُورًا

translations.saheeh: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
translations.pickthall: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
translations.khattab: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning
translations.arberry: Has there come on man a while of time when he was a thing unremembered?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
translations.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
translations.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening
translations.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord at dawn and in the evening

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
translations.pickthall: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
translations.khattab: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
translations.arberry: Surely this is a Reminder; so he who will, takes unto his Lord a way.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱلۡمُلۡقِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا

translations.saheeh: And those [angels] who deliver a message
translations.pickthall: By those who bring down the Reminder,
translations.khattab: and those delivering revelation
translations.arberry: and those hurling a reminder

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ

translations.saheeh: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
translations.pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
translations.khattab: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving
translations.arberry: upon the day when man shall remember what he has striven,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ

translations.saheeh: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
translations.pickthall: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
translations.khattab: But it is not for you to tell its time
translations.arberry: What art thou about, to mention it?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
translations.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
translations.khattab: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder
translations.arberry: or yet remember, and the Reminder profit him.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
translations.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
translations.khattab: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder
translations.arberry: or yet remember, and the Reminder profit him.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
translations.pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
translations.khattab: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder
translations.arberry: No indeed; it is a Reminder

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

translations.saheeh: So whoever wills may remember it.
translations.pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
translations.khattab: So let whoever wills be mindful of it
translations.arberry: (and whoso wills, shall remember it)

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
translations.pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
translations.khattab: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—
translations.arberry: It is naught but a Reminder unto all beings,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

translations.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
translations.khattab: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺
translations.arberry: Therefore remind, if the Reminder profits,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
translations.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
translations.khattab: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺
translations.arberry: Therefore remind, if the Reminder profits,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ

translations.pickthall: He will heed who feareth,
translations.khattab: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺
translations.arberry: and he who fears shall remember,

translations.khattab: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray
translations.arberry: and mentions the Name of his Lord, and prays.

translations.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
translations.khattab: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind
translations.arberry: Then remind them! Thou art only a reminder;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
translations.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
translations.khattab: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind
translations.arberry: Then remind them! Thou art only a reminder;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
translations.pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
translations.khattab: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then
translations.arberry: and Gehenna is brought out, upon that day man will remember; and how shall the Reminder be for him?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: And [by] He who created the male and female,
translations.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
translations.khattab: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female
translations.arberry: and That which created the male and the female,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ

translations.saheeh: And raised high for you your repute.
translations.pickthall: And exalted thy fame?
translations.khattab: and elevated your renown for you
translations.arberry: Did We not exalt thy fame?
